summary: Frontend-only visual/DOM verification of the Coco AI home page hero engine diagram (desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x820) and code review of components/analyze-flow.tsx. All requested requirements from the review request are met: 7 unique premium glyph tiles render on both viewports, the Coco core has NO white circle ring (dark radial-gradient glass orb with violet glow, dashed halo orbit + conic sweep), wire pulse animation is slow (6.3s per wire, staggered 0.9s apart), the desktop blurred SVG glow filter is absent on the mobile layout (glow = id === 'd'), and heavy mobile animations (.coco-core-aura, .coco-core-beat box-shadow beat) are disabled/toned-down under 640px via the media query at coco.css:2503. Zero console errors on the home page. AnalyzeFlow (components/analyze-flow.tsx) code review confirms 6 unique premium glyphs (Neural, CandleCaliper, Pressure, Levels, Momentum, BiasLock) + core, distinct desktop (ad) and mobile (am) layouts, and .aflow-pulse animation duration of 3.2s (globals.css:2637). Analyzer runtime not executed (requires Firebase auth + Groq credits) per instructions.
verified_facts: engine-diagram, engine-core and all 7 engine-tile-{otc,real,live,future,news,risk,feed} render on desktop and mobile (each has count=2 across the two responsive Diagram instances, matching CocoEngine rendering both layouts and toggling via sm:hidden / hidden sm:block).

Core computed background = radial-gradient(circle at 32% 24%, rgba(156,116,255,0.5), rgba(10,6,24,0.92) 68%); no white background. The only white presence is the 1px inset highlight ring (rgba(255,255,255,0.14)) which is the intentional glass rim, not a white ring.
Desktop wire .coco-dash-seq computed animation-duration = 6.3s (= 7 wires * 0.9s step), staggered via inline animationDelay = i * 0.9s. Mobile identical (6.3s).
Mobile diagram (.sm:hidden) SVG paths contain zero filter attributes -> blurred glow only rendered on desktop layout (id==='d').
Mobile computed .coco-core-aura animation-name = 'none' (heavy aura animation disabled under 640px).
Zero JS console errors on the landing page during load.
analyze_flow_code_review: AnalyzeFlow renders 6 tiles + aflow-core with distinct desktop (ad, 520x300) and mobile (am, 320x380) layouts.
.aflow-pulse animation duration set to 3.2s linear infinite in globals.css:2637.
Glow filter only applied when id==='ad' (desktop) — mobile stays light, matching the home page pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In coco-engine.tsx the desktop svg <feGaussianBlur> filter has no explicit color-interpolation-filters attribute; harmless but adds a small perf hit on desktop only (not applicable to mobile).
Minor: coco.css has two @media (max-width: 640px) blocks (lines 199 and 2503). Both are valid but consolidating would improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page engine diagram + AnalyzeFlow verified. No fixes needed. If a future change touches coco-engine.tsx or coco.css, re-verify: (a) wire animation-duration equals wires.length*step (currently 6.3s), (b) mobile aura animation-name resolves to 'none', (c) mobile SVG paths have no filter attribute, (d) core computed backgroundImage remains a radial-gradient with no white/light base color.
